Title: Recure of the Homeland + Mirror Walk

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Simply put:
Jacob the Glitch is in torpor. He attempts a Recure of the Homeland
action (or even a regular "leave torpor" action; it doesn't matter for
this example).

Lambach attempts to block, with Enhanced Senses.

Jacob plays Mirror Walk at superior.

Lambach is still successfully blocking.

Mirror Walk at superior says:
"...if this action is blocked, the action ends (with no combat)."

Does this also stop Lambach from committing diablerie?

Probably yes, but I wanted to confirm it.

Thanks.
